zh: 我有一个认识十年的朋友，他总是帮我。
old_en: I have a friend I've known for ten years, who always helps me.
new_en: I have a friend I've known for ten years, who always helps me.

zh: 我认识一个朋友十年了，每次需要帮忙他都在。
old_en: I've known a friend for ten years, who's always there to help me.
new_en: I've known a friend for ten years, and he's always there when I need help.

zh: 我和同事相处得很好，经常一起吃饭。
old_en: I get along well with my colleagues, who often eat meals with me.
new_en: I get along well with my coworkers, and we often eat together.

zh: 我认识几个大学同学很多年了，我们每年聚一次。
old_en: I've known several university classmates for many years, and we've met up annually.
new_en: I've known several university friends for many years, and we meet once a year.

zh: 一个认识多年的朋友去年搬走了，我们还经常联系。
old_en: A friend I've known for years moved last year, but we still keep in touch.
new_en: A friend I've known for years moved last year, but we still stay in touch.

zh: 新认识的同事和我很聊得来，经常一起吃饭。
old_en: The new colleague I've met and I get along well, often having meals together.
new_en: I've become good friends with a new colleague, and we often eat together.

zh: 我和邻居经常互相照应。
old_en: I have often helped my neighbors, who live next door.
new_en: My neighbors and I often help each other out.

zh: 大学同学我认识很多年了，大家每年聚一次。
old_en: I've known many of my college friends for years, and we meet up annually.
new_en: I've known many college friends for years, and we get together once a year.

zh: 我和姐姐从小相处得很好，无话不谈。
old_en: I've known my sister intimately since childhood, sharing everything.
new_en: I've been close with my sister since childhood, we talk about everything.

zh: 有一个朋友总在我需要的时候出现。
old_en: There has been a friend with me at just the right time.
new_en: There's a friend who always shows up when I need help.

zh: 我有个朋友，每次我遇到困难他都会来。
old_en: My friend has helped me many times when I've been in trouble.
new_en: Whenever I'm in trouble, my friend comes to help.

zh: 我和室友一直分担家务。
old_en: We have been sharing housework with our roommate since we moved in.
new_en: My roommate and I share household chores.

zh: 我的一个老朋友搬到别的城市了。
old_en: I've lost touch with one of my old friends who moved to another city.
new_en: One of my old friends moved to another city, and we lost touch.

zh: 我最近认识了一个新朋友，我们很聊得来。
old_en: I've met a new friend recently who I get along with well.
new_en: I recently met a new friend who I get along with well.

zh: 我和同事们关系一直不错，工作中互相帮忙。
old_en: I have helped my colleagues a lot, who I get along with well.
new_en: I get along well with my colleagues, and we help each other at work.

zh: 邻居之间一直互相帮忙，关系很好。
old_en: Neighbors have helped each other a lot, making their relationship very good.
new_en: Neighbors help each other a lot, so they have a good relationship.

zh: 我和姐姐无话不谈，遇到事总找她商量。
old_en: I have talked to my sister about everything, who I often seek advice from.
new_en: I talk to my sister about everything and often ask her for advice.

zh: 我和室友相处得不错，家务一直一起做。
old_en: I have got along well with my roommate, who we always do chores together.
new_en: I get along well with my roommate, and we do chores together.

zh: 我有一个家人，我每周都会和他视频。
old_en: I have a family member whom I video call every week.
new_en: I have a family member. I video call him every week.

zh: 我有一位家人，我们每周都会视频聊天。
old_en: I have a family member with whom we video chat every week.
new_en: I have a family member with whom we video chat every week.
